shared_elements: horizontal registers stacked one above another
a row of repeated similar figures
narrow band of repeating ornament separating registers
justification: Both surfaces organise profile figures into horizontally stacked registers divided by narrow bands of repeating ornament, with repetition of near-identical forms along each row being the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they differ sharply: A is a rough, weathered, boldly modelled block dominated by animals and irregular spacing, whereas B is a smooth, finely detailed, shallow relief of uniformly spaced clothed human figures marching along a long wall.
